Classifies the sensitivity level of data on an object or column. Allowed values are ordered from most to least sensitive. If you are on Enterprise Edition or higher, a role with APPLY TAG ON ACCOUNT can enable automatic propagation by running ALTER TAG SNOWFLAKE.TAGS.SENSITIVITY SET PROPAGATE = ON_DEPENDENCY_AND_DATA_MOVEMENT ON_CONFLICT = ALLOWED_VALUES_SEQUENCE, which makes the most sensitive value win on conflict.
